behaviorArchitecture.title: How a plan digest page is built, checked and read
behaviorArchitecture.summary: The assembler wraps the planner's region with the template, rail counts, shadow-root illustrations and task dialogs, then runs the lint. The lint and the extractor read slice cards with one shared reader, so the gate text matches what the page draws.
behaviorArchitecture.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  component1["Planner-written page region"]:::external
  component2["plan.md tasks and slice manifest"]:::external
  component3["Page assembler"]:::touched
  component4["Page template styles and script"]:::touched
  component5["Illustration files"]:::external
  component6["Assembled digest page"]:::touched
  component7["Page lint"]:::touched
  component8["Text extractor"]:::touched
  component9["Gate and PR readers"]:::touched
  component10["Reviewer browser"]:::external
  component3 -->|wraps| component1
  component3 -->|reads counts and task specs from| component2
  component3 -->|inlines| component4
  component3 -->|embeds in a shadow root| component5
  component3 -->|writes| component6
  component3 -->|runs once| component7
  component7 -->|checks slice cards, decide and handles in| component6
  component8 -->|reads slice cards through| component7
  component8 -->|prints text from| component6
  component9 -->|reads the summary from| component8
  component10 -->|renders| component6
  classDef new stroke:#2e7d32,stroke-width:3px
  classDef touched stroke:#f9a825,stroke-width:3px
  classDef removed stroke:#c62828,stroke-width:3px,stroke-dasharray:4 3
  classDef external stroke:#888888,stroke-dasharray:3 3
dependencyChanges: No dependency-direction changes: the assembler already read plan.md and illustration files, and the lint and extractor already shared readers.
Changed Page assembler → Page lint: it runs once, with no second run to write a banner.
Changed Text extractor → Page lint: it reads slice cards through slice_cards instead of tier-table rows.

architecture.title: From the amendments to the shipped tools
architecture.summary: The ADR amendments set the shapes, docs/plan-digest.md specifies them, and the template, assembler, lint and extractor implement them. The skills teach and read the new page, and the test suites and three-plan eval check it.

flows.title: Assemble and lint a digest page
flows.summary: The planner runs the assembler on its region. The assembler builds the page from the template, plan.md and illustration files, then runs the lint once.
flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant P as Planner (writing-plans)
  participant A as assemble.py
  participant M as plan.md
  participant T as Template css and js
  participant I as Illustration file
  participant L as lint.py
  P->>A: assemble.sh folder, region in human.html
  A->>M: read slice manifest and task blocks
  A->>T: inline stylesheet and script
  A->>I: parse and reject scripts, page CSS, host rules
  A->>A: wrap body in shadow root with id illus-slug
  A->>A: build rail counts and task dialogs
  A->>P: write human.html atomically
  A->>L: run lint.sh once, no banner
  L->>L: check timeline, slice cards, proof pairs, decide order, handles
  L-->>P: exit 0 with WARN lines, or 1 with violations

flows.title: Gate summary reads slice cards
flows.summary: The gate and PR steps call the extractor, which reads slice cards through the lint's shared reader and prints one line per card.
flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant G as Gate or PR step
  participant X as extract.py
  participant H as human.html
  participant L as lint.py readers
  G->>X: extract.sh folder summary or tier-table
  X->>H: parse the page
  X->>L: slice_cards on the build-order section
  L-->>X: cards with chips, proof pairs, module tags
  X->>X: one line per card, assertion paired with command
  X->>L: handle rows and key-handle cards
  X-->>G: text-only reading for the gate

flows.title: Open and close a task dialog
flows.summary: A reviewer opens a task's execution spec from a chip, and the Close button closes it by script.
flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant R as Reviewer
  participant J as digest.js
  participant D as dialog task-N from assemble.py
  R->>J: click a data-task chip
  J->>D: showModal
  R->>J: click the Close button, data-close
  J->>D: close()
  D-->>J: close event, focus returns to the chip
